text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The 2,400m Yushun Himba was a very 
difficult race for me. My body grew 
exhausted and it got so painful...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Normally, the next race would be the Shuka 
Sho, but... Trainer told me that there's a 
completely different "stage" waiting for 
me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
The sprint GⅠ, the Sprinters Stakes. All 
of a sudden, I ended up having to compete 
against the Senior class girls...!
